description:
Most creators still pay hundreds of dollars for motion graphics, templates, or editors. But you can now create motion graphics using code in this Remotion Tutorial.

In this video, I show you the exact system I now use to create unlimited, pixel-perfect motion graphics with AI, without relying on After Effects templates or dealing with endless back-and-forth revisions.

This approach is built around structure, not guesswork, which means your text, numbers, and layouts stay clean and editable every time.

In the video, I walk through real use cases including:

- Animated charts and graphs
- Animated explainers
- Timelines and counters
Tweets, subscribe buttons, and lower thirds

Everything you see is generated programmatically, so changing data or text does not break the animation.

🧠 WORKFLOW (MIRO BOARD)

I’ve organized the full workflow, use cases, and example prompts in this Miro board:
👉 https://miro.com/app/board/uXjVGM66HiU=/?share_link_id=80594234260

You can use it as a reference or starting point to build your own motion graphics system.

WHO THIS IS FOR

This video is for:

- Creators tired of broken AI visuals
- Anyone paying for motion graphics they want to control themselves
- People who care about accuracy, not just flashy animations
- You do not need to know how to code to follow along.

If this helped you and you want more tutorials on building practical AI systems like this, drop a like and subscribe.

Thanks for watching.

This video shows how to generate high quality motion graphics using code, AI, and Remotion, making it a compelling alternative to traditional tools like After Effects. Learn the process with this motion graphics tutorial, even if you don't know how to code, thanks to ai automation. Discover how motion graphics with code can simplify your workflow.
